metaTitle: Brewing Buddha Case Study: 24M+ Views | Button Up Media
metaDescription: How Button Up Media made short videos for Brewing Buddha Cafe & Arthouse, a coffee shop and art space in Pinecrest, that have reached 24M+ video views.
ldHeadline: Brewing Buddha Cafe & Arthouse: 24M+ social video views for a Pinecrest coffee shop
h1Sub: 24M+ video views for a Pinecrest cafe
answer: Brewing Buddha Cafe & Arthouse is a coffee shop and art space in Pinecrest. Our short videos about its creative lattes reached 24M+ views on Instagram, YouTube, TikTok and Facebook.

hero.alt: A Brewing Buddha barista reacts to a party-size Cookie Butter Latte order, from a Reel we made with 7.4M views

metrics.label: Video views
metrics.meaning: Instagram Reels 11.8M, YouTube 6.6M, TikTok 4.0M and Facebook 1.7M, measured in Sprout Social from January 2022 to November 2026.

metrics.label: Followers
metrics.meaning: That's across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and YouTube, and 33.8K of those followers were gained since 2022.

metrics.label: Engagement rate
metrics.meaning: This is how often people who see a post like, comment on or share it. A higher rate means more of the people who see the posts are reacting to them.

reels.intro: Tap any Reel to watch it with sound. View counts are what Instagram showed on Nov 16, 2026.

paragraphs: Brewing Buddha is a coffee shop and art space known for its creative lattes.
In his video testimonial, owner Jordan Athos says they needed somebody to match their energy.

items.title: Film the lattes and the art space
items.bodyHtml: We make short videos about the creative lattes and the art space.

items.title: Share ideas back and forth
items.bodyHtml: Both our team and theirs pitch video ideas, and we make the best ones.

items.title: Build on what does well
items.bodyHtml: Our February 2025 video about their butter coffee did especially well, and later we made a follow-up about a maple waffle latte.

items.title: views on one behind-the-counter skit
items.body: In this Reel, a barista reacts to a party-size Cookie Butter Latte order meant for 10 people. It has 7.4M views and 576K likes, which is more than half of all the views across the account's 261 Reels.

items.title: of all Reel views came from three staff skits
items.body: The top three Reels are all staff comedy about over-the-top orders, posted from June to September 2026. Together they have about 9.4M of the 12.5M views on @brewingbuddha. When a format like this works, we keep making more of it.

items.title: views on a follow-up to the butter coffee video
items.body: The butter coffee video did well, so the team created a maple waffle latte and we made a follow-up video about it.

items.title: of working together, and the manager says “the quality never drops”
items.body: In a November 2026 Google review, manager Josh wrote that the account has “several videos over a million views” and brought “an influx of new customers.”

points: Owner Jordan Athos went on camera in August 2024 to talk about working with us. You can watch it on this page.

quote.text: They bring creative ideas, they're not afraid to push the lines, we needed somebody to match our energy, we bounce off ideas and work as a team.
quote.name: Jordan Athos
